name: czech_01
context: A Czech post from the Facebook page of one of nine popular Czech brands, collected in 2013 and kept as text only. Two annotators labelled the sentiment towards the brand, product or service of the page, and a third and a fourth annotator settled their disagreements. Complaints are negative, joy or praise about the brand is positive, and a post whose opinion does not concern the page is neutral. Posts that were both positive and negative were removed.

versions.analysis_for_next:
Version 3 scored 80.5. Neutral precision improved (neutral→positive fell from 51 to 22), but positive recall dropped from 142 to 124 and negative recall from 109 to 101.

Positive texts that went to neutral:
- thanks that are not attached to a request, even inside an informative message ('už mi mail dorazil, děkuji :-)', 'E-mail je: ... Mockrát Vám děkuji :)', 'Děkuji za reakci... ještě jednou děkuji', 'Díky, Anděl mám znatelně blíž :)');
- happy short updates about buying, having or visiting with a smiley ('Nakoupeno :)', 'už je mám na cestě :-)', 'my byli v neděli v solné jeskyni :-)', 'jj sou to sestřičky ;-)))');
- mild praise ('mě chutnalo ;)', 'je dobrej :-D', 'vtipné', 'Sdílím je jedinečné :)').

Negative texts that went to neutral:
- disappointment with :( or :/ about missing out or unavailability ('škoda,že u nás prší :/', 'nikde ... není :(', 'přišel pozdě..:-(', 'nevěřím ... výhře:(');
- 'why did you stop / why don't you' questions about brand decisions ('Zajímalo by mě z jakých důvodů se už nenabízí...', 'Proč máte nastavené mazání...');
- resigned complaints ('cekani kolem 1hodiny bohuzel normalni').

The remaining neutral→negative errors are mostly banter, irony and teasing between users, flat fault reports and price facts.

Changes:
- Restore thanks as positive unless it closes a question or request.
- Treat cheerful personal updates with a smiley and mild praise as positive.
- Treat disappointment with :( or :/ and questions objecting to brand decisions as negative.
- Keep information questions, requests, contest entries, flat fault reports, user banter and teasing, promo text and jokes neutral.

versions.analysis_for_next:
Version 5 is the best so far (81.7). The remaining errors are small groups, so I keep its structure and make targeted edits only.

1. Neutral→negative (39): mostly ironic or teasing replies to other users and price facts. I add a banter example to neutral and state that irony or teasing aimed at other users, and price facts, are neutral.

2. Negative→neutral (20): many object to the brand's own choices ('nechápu, proč nedáte odkaz', 'bez prasátka to už neni ono'). Making all 'why' questions negative hurt neutral in v4, so I only name 'nechápu'-style objections and regret over a removed product or mascot as negative.

3. Positive→neutral (16): smiley-only updates are noisy, since gold labels split both ways on near-identical texts, so I leave them alone.

The previous draft was 436 words, so this version trims the rule, cues and not_for fields to get under the 400-word limit.

Version 7 is the best so far (83.8). The tie-breaker and the promo/non-brand-joy rule lifted neutral recall to 268/325 while keeping positive (136) and negative (103) reasonable, so I keep it almost unchanged.

Remaining errors:
1. Neutral→negative (34): many sit near 0.5. They are ironic musings or speculation ('Byl bych zvedavej kolik lidi vola Čezu...', 'Kéž bych měl tolik peněz...', 'Chuck měl udělat reklamu...'), price facts, and teasing. Fix: add 'musing or speculation' to the neutral list in the rule.
2. Negative→neutral (15): a few involve continuing outages or unanswered waits ('Je 16 hodin a stále to nefunguje', 'Dočkám se reakce... před 23 hodinami?'). Fix: add 'stále nefunguje' (still not working) as a negative cue, in place of the less useful 'chudák'.
3. Positive→neutral (18): mostly smiley-only updates, where gold labels are inconsistent. I leave them alone.

Otherwise the wording stays the same, keeping the word count under 400.

Version 8 is the best so far (85.1), with neutral recall at 279/325. Most remaining errors are borderline cases with probabilities near 0.5, or texts where the gold labels themselves are inconsistent: smiley-only updates labelled positive, and sad-smiley contest notes labelled neutral. Large changes have repeatedly caused swings, so I make a single minimal edit.

When version 8 swapped the cue 'chudák' (poor thing) for 'stále nefunguje', the negative example 'Chudák kočka,....:-/' slipped to neutral (0.43 neutral vs 0.40 negative). I restore 'chudák' to the negative cues. To keep the word count unchanged, I drop the generic 'kde (where)' from the neutral cues; 'jak (how)' and 'prosím (please)' still cover questions.

Everything else stays as in version 8.

Version 9 is the best so far (85.7), with balanced errors: 23 neutral→positive, 21 neutral→negative, 18 positive→neutral, and 18 negative→neutral.

Most remaining errors are borderline, with probabilities near 0.5, or come from inconsistent gold labels: smiley-only updates labelled positive in some cases and neutral in others, and sad-smiley contest notes labelled neutral. Further broad edits have repeatedly caused large swings, so this final version keeps version 9 almost intact.

The one change: the explicit enthusiasm 'KLOBOUK DOLŮ!!... paráda' was mislabelled negative, so I replace the generic cue 'super' with the Czech 'paráda' (great) among the positive cues. This keeps the word count the same.
